normalization: Date.now is fixed to 1730000000000 when used.
Temporary history root is rendered as <APPDATA>; path separators are normalized in error text.
limitations: Frozen original functions or statement ranges run in a Node VM. Declared IO seams are supplied by the runner; this is not a full server or Electron end-to-end run.
Uses real files with a narrow Node fs adapter at the fs-extra IO boundary; rename failure is injected.
